title: America 250 Highlights
summary: Thank you to the amazing Senoia community for showing up, celebrating, and making this weekend so special! Enjoy a few America 250 Weekend Highlights captured by Emmanuel Brooks Photography!
body_html:
Thank you to the amazing Senoia community for showing up, celebrating, and making this weekend so special! A huge thank you to the City of Senoia and the Downtown Development Authority for their dedication in making this celebration possible.

From our moving flag ceremony honoring our new Veterans Memorial, to the Freedom Run 5K, an unforgettable performance by David Lee Murphy, Six Piece Suits, and spectacular fireworks lighting up the sky both nights, every moment reflected what makes Senoia such a special place.

Thank you to everyone who volunteered, participated, sponsored, attended, and celebrated with us.

Photos by Emmanuel Brooks

title: Commemorative Banners to Honor Local Veterans in Senoia
summary: The Senoia Downtown Development Authority is proud to announce the availability of special commemorative banners to honor and recognize the valiant service of Veterans in the United States Armed Services
body_html:
The Senoia Downtown Development Authority is proud to announce the availability of special commemorative banners to honor and recognize the valiant service of Veterans in the United States Armed Services.

Each custom-made banner will feature the Veteran's name, photograph, and branch of service, creating a powerful visual testament to their service. The banners will be displayed proudly, and prominently along Main Street. This initiative is designed to bring our community together in paying respect to the men and women who are serving and have served our nation with honor.

Each banner is $150
‍

Deadline: April 1st, 2026

‍
Please send a photo of your Veteran to chairman@enjoysenoia.com to be used on their banner. Preferably from Coweta County.

Photos below are from previous years. In honor of Veterans Day in November, we host a brief ceremony to present these banners to each Veteran and/or their families.

title: Senoia's Business of the Month
summary: Downtown Senoia's Business of the Month, Maguire's Irish Pub.
body_html:
We would like to congratulate the Downtown Senoia Business of the Month, Maguire's Irish Pub.

Maguires Family and Friends restaurant and Irish Pub opened its doors on St. Patrick’s Day 2008.

Owned by Frank and Wendy Maguire, working along side their three children, they are now in their second generation of this true family business. It is their mission to honor their heritage by always providing the great food, great fun, and great service upon which their Grandmother and Grandfather prided themselves.

Maguires has a menu that can make anyone happy, from Fish and Chips, to Cottage Pie, and have you had the Reuben Spring Rolls? ( My personal favorite).  Their drink menu also has something for everyone, with a nice variety of beer and wine, and their handrafted cocktails such as the Irish Old Fashioned.

Happy Hour is daily from 2-6pm, where you can choose from discounted appetizers, and $4 house wines and cocktails, and select draft beer specials.

All of Senoia looks forward to the St. Patrick’s Day Shenanigans, and Maguires does not disappoint! This year the fun begins on Saturday, with Kegs and Eggs at 8am, and finishing the day with a performance by the Kelly Porter Irish Dancers at 6pm. The fun continues into Sunday, and then Monday is the big day, beginning at 8am, with events all day!

Downtown Senoia is fortunate to have such a great establishment that truly cares about its customers and their experience.
